title: RgpotPot
description: config.ini [RgpotPot] section (RgpotPot). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

backend.description: rgpot backend: 'nwchemc', 'cpmdc', 'metatomic', or 'xtb' (aliases: nwchem/cpmd/mta/gfn). metatomic/xtb dlopen libmetatomic_engine.so / libxtb_engine.so for packaging.

basis.description: Basis set for the NWChem backend.

nwchem_basis.description: Alias of basis, read when basis is absent.

theory.description: Theory level for the NWChem backend.

nwchem_theory.description: Alias of theory, read when theory is absent.

scf_type.description: SCF type for the NWChem backend.

nwchem_scf_type.description: Alias of scf_type, read when scf_type is absent.

functional.description: XC functional for the CPMD backend. [cpmd] functional overrides this key when params_path is empty.

cpmd_functional.description: Alias of functional, read when functional is absent.

cutoff_ry.description: Plane-wave cutoff (Ry) for the CPMD backend. [cpmd] cutOffRy overrides this key when params_path is empty.

cutOffRy.description: Alias of cutoff_ry that wins over it when both are set.

cpmd_cut_off_ry.description: Alias of cutoff_ry, read when cutOffRy and cutoff_ry are absent.

nwchem_charge.description: Alias of charge, read when charge is absent.

nwchem_multiplicity.description: Alias of multiplicity, read when multiplicity is absent.

engine_library.description: Alias for engine_path; used when engine_path is empty.

xtb_paramset.description: Alias of paramset, read when paramset is absent.

xtb_accuracy.description: Alias of accuracy, read when accuracy is absent.

xtb_electronic_temperature.description: Alias of electronic_temperature, read when that key is absent.

xtb_max_iterations.description: Alias of max_iterations, read when max_iterations is absent.

xtb_uhf.description: Alias of uhf, read when uhf is absent.

xtb_charge.description: XTB total charge when backend=xtb. An omitted key uses charge.

title.description: Job title passed to the engine.

memory_mb.description: Engine memory limit in MB (0 uses the engine default).

input_block.description: Verbatim input block. For NWChem this is inputBlocks. For CPMD, [cpmd] input_block overrides this key and the text is appended to the message inputBlocks.

permanent_dir.description: CPMD FILEPATH directory for RESTART files (backend=cpmdc).

params_path.description: Path to a Cap'n Proto CPMDParams message. The file owns the CPMD method, including inputSections and inputBlocks, and the scalar keys are not written over it. input_block is appended to inputBlocks. engine_path, engine_root, scratch_dir, and permanent_dir still place the run.

ranks_per_image.description: Split the MPI world into groups of this many ranks, one CPMD session per group, and spread NEB images over the groups. 0 keeps one session on every rank.
